headline: Altria Group (MO) Faces Investigation Over On! PLUS FDA Disclosure Claims
summary: Levi & Korsinsky has opened an investigation into Altria Group regarding disclosures tied to the FDA regulatory status of its on! PLUS nicotine pouch product. The review focuses on whether Altria accurately described near term FDA authorization prospects for on! PLUS in its public statements. This action introduces an additional legal and regulatory consideration for investors following NYSE:MO.
